ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Use the one-proportion margin-of-error formula E = z * sqrt(p_hat(1 - p_hat) / n). From the survey, n = 1700, p_hat = 0.17, so 1 - p_hat = 0.83, and E = 0.02. The standard error is sqrt(0.17 * 0.83 / 1700) = sqrt(0.1411 / 1700) ≈ 0.0091. Solve for z: z = 0.02 / 0.0091 ≈ 2.20. The confidence level is the central normal probability between -2.20 and 2.20: 2Φ(2.20) - 1 = 2(0.9861) - 1 = 0.9722, or about 97.2%.
